title: On the little green place.
html_source:
The song is of “Lilly Dale”, and the original lyrics are “o'er her little green grave”– his parents have sweetened the tragic element.

Listen to the original song here.

anchor.prefix:
looked at him through a glass: he had a hairy face.

 He was baby tuckoo. The moocow came down the road where Betty Byrne lived: she sold lemon platt.

 O, the wild rose blossoms
